items: 【Magnetically Detachable Keyboard】case for Samsung Galaxy Tab A9 Plus 11 inch comes with a detachable magnetic keyboard. The ultra-thin and lightweight magnetic keyboard can be firmly attached to the case, which helps the tablet stand upright and turn it into a mini laptop in less than a second. You can move and change the keyboard position at any time according to your usual preferences.

【Adjustable Viewing Angles and Support for Pen】case supports 3 viewing angles and has anti-slip slots. Move the tablet forward or backward along the case to choose a suitable angle to use the tablet for writing, viewing, reading, drawing, etc. Built-in Pen holder makes it easy to carry the Pen with your device. (NOTE: Pen not included!).

【Auto Sleep/Wake Function】The protective case has an automatic sleep/wake function to protect and save the battery life of your tablet. When the lid is opened, the tablet wakes up; when the lid is closed, the tablet goes to sleep. (NOTE: Tablet not included!).

【Premium Protection】keyboard case for Samsung Galaxy Tab A9 Plus / A9+ 11 inch has full edge coverage and provides full 360° protection against scratches, bumps or dents, protecting your tablet from all kinds of dropping accidents. The inner layer provides cushioning with Honeycomb grid pattern, protects your tablet from overheating and increases its lifespan by more than 30%.
